exposure: Presence or absence of placental lacunae
cohort: 58 patients with placenta previa who underwent cesarean section between 36 and 38 weeks of gestation.
finding: The size and number of placental lacunae, as well as the thickness of the myometrium below the placenta, can be used to predict the amount of postpartum hemorrhage and operating time in patients with placenta previa, allowing for optimal preoperative preparation.
